key.name: top-metric
key.description: What the top line of the panel indicator shows: 'spend_month', 'spend_today', 'balance' or 'none'.

key.name: bottom-metric
key.description: What the bottom line of the panel indicator shows: 'spend_month', 'spend_today', 'balance' or 'none'.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: Seconds between reads of the status cache file.

key.name: show-zero-balance
key.description: Whether to list providers with no balance and no monthly spend.

key.name: show-label
key.description: Whether to show the spend/balance text next to the panel icon.

key.name: balance-warn
key.description: Providers with a prepaid balance below this amount show an amber health dot.

key.name: balance-critical
key.description: Providers with a prepaid balance below this amount show a red health dot.
